summary: A modular 1.22 x 2.44 m indoor climbing-wall panel: an 18 mm ply sheet with textured paint and a 200 mm T-nut… options holds, route_a_colour, route_b_colour; sockets socket_start, socket_top.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.climbing_wall_panel or place "prefab": "climbing_wall_panel" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
